about: Rachel E. Ellis attended law school and graduated from University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 2008. Rachel Ellis began practicing law in 2008.
Rachel Ellis is an attorney at Livelihood Law, LLC, helping people with Employment & Labor: Employee issues. Livelihood Law, LLC has an office in Denver, Colorado, serving the local community.

Rachel Ellis was selected to Super Lawyers for 2022 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
